Summary: Define and approve the Review 1 screening-to-support blueprint
Description:
## Objective

Provide a defensible business flow showing how MentalBridge moves from eligibility and standardized screening to reviewed support, optional specialist involvement, follow-up, reassessment, and descriptive progress evaluation.

## Scope

- Define the initial Vietnam target cohort of adults aged 18–30 as a product scope rather than a medical cutoff.
- Record exact PHQ-9 and GAD-7 source/version, vi-VN provenance, validation population, publication rights, reviewer, and publication state.
- Define screening-result terminology, non-diagnostic wording, and prohibited claims.
- Approve or explicitly block a deterministic severity-to-support matrix that keeps item-9 safety status independent.
- Define the specialist recommendation and handoff journey, data minimization, scoped consent, entitlement, and unavailable-runtime behavior.
- Define follow-up entry/exit, cadence ownership, reassessment, and descriptive progress comparison.
- Create a Review 1 closure matrix and mentor-facing end-to-end flow.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The target-cohort decision explains inclusion, exclusion, why the MVP starts at 18, why it ends at 30, and that 30 is not a clinical threshold.
- [ ] PHQ-9 and GAD-7 each have an instrument register entry with exact source, wording/version, locale, validated population, publication rights, accountable reviewers, and publication gate.
- [ ] GAD-7 remains unpublished unless every required provenance and approval field is complete.
- [ ] Terminology distinguishes screening result from diagnosis, disease severity, treatment recommendation, and clinical outcome.
- [ ] The routing matrix keeps screeningLevel, safetyStatus, supportTier, supportActions, and entitlementPlan independent.
- [ ] No score directly diagnoses a condition, mandates treatment, or claims specialist/emergency response.
- [ ] The item-9 path remains independent from the PHQ-9 band and does not infer intent, plan, imminence, or urgency from values 1–3.
- [ ] Specialist handoff defines user-visible behavior, optional recommendation, scoped consent, minimum shared data, entitlement/availability checks, and runtime-unavailable fallback.
- [ ] Follow-up defines who owns cadence, entry/exit conditions, missing or stale assessments, reassessment behavior, and continue/adapt/escalate wording boundaries.
- [ ] Progress comparison defines baseline, current result, absolute delta, screening-level transition, instrument-version compatibility, insufficient-data behavior, and non-causal wording.
- [ ] Every unresolved clinical, legal, privacy, or product choice has an owner, approval state, deadline or explicit defer decision; engineering does not invent a default.
- [ ] A Review 1 closure matrix links every mentor feedback item to a decision artifact, evidence source, reviewer, approval, runtime status, and follow-up Jira issue.

## Definition of Done

- [ ] All Acceptance Criteria are satisfied.
- [ ] The business flow is versioned and reviewed by the product owner and supervisor/mentor.
- [ ] Clinical content and routing are approved by the accountable domain expert or remain explicitly blocked and unpublished.
- [ ] Consent, retention, and data-sharing boundaries receive the required security/legal review or remain explicitly blocked.
- [ ] PHQ-9, GAD-7, support, consent, domain, coverage, and traceability documents do not contain conflicting status or terminology.
- [ ] The end-to-end diagram and decision tables are understandable without reading implementation code.
- [ ] Runtime-complete, definition-complete, approval-blocked, and deferred work are clearly distinguished.
- [ ] Related Jira sub-tasks and review comments are complete.
- [ ] No known Critical or High policy ambiguity is silently treated as resolved.

## Evidence

- Jira: Assigned during import
- Policies: PHQ-9, GAD-7, Care support/intervention, and Care consent/retention
- Architecture: ADR 0009, domain/use cases, module coverage, and requirements traceability
- Research: instrument validation and localization sources recorded in the provenance register
- Review artifact: Review 1 closure matrix and mentor-facing flow
- Pull Request: To be added

## Completion Notes

To be completed after each Review 1 feedback item has a recorded disposition and required approval evidence. Definition does not claim that deferred specialist, follow-up, GAD-7, or progress runtime is implemented.
